newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia retail sales Jan-Oct up 0.21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Colombia retail sales Jan-Oct up 0.21 percent.

text.p: Retail sales in Colombia's 12 largest cities grew 0.21 percent from January through October compared with the same period in 1995, the National Statistics Department said Thursday.
But excluding vehicle sales, retail sales fell 2.49 percent, compared with the same period last year.

In October, retail sales, excluding vehicles and fuel, dropped 1.02 percent. The sectors least affected by the slump were pharmaceutical sales, up 8.54 percent in October, food, drink and tobacco, up 3.37 percent in the month and clothing, up 3.35 percent, the statistics department said.
